rai:dataCollection.evidence: Data combine large-scale real-world robotic datasets Fang et al. (2023); Collaboration et al. (2023); Liu et al. (2024c); Wu et al. (2024); Bu et al. (2025) with curated in-house collection, narrowing the sim-to-real gap.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: Data combine large-scale real-world robotic datasets Fang et al. (2023); Collaboration et al. (2023); Liu et al. (2024c); Wu et al. (2024); Bu et al. (2025) with curated in-house collection, narrowing the sim-to-real gap.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: Data combine large-scale real-world robotic datasets Fang et al. (2023); Collaboration et al. (2023); Liu et al. (2024c); Wu et al. (2024); Bu et al. (2025) with curated in-house collection, narrowing the sim-to-real gap.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: We apply both general and task-specific filters. General criteria address image quality and task validity, while sub-benchmarks have tailored rules—such as excluding single-arm data from dual-arm tasks.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: Gemini Comanici et al. (2025) generates structured annotations—task summaries, step-wise instructions with timestamps, and metadata (objects, actions, scenes, embodiments)—which are refined by human annotators.

rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis.evidence: We further adopt a majority-vote strategy Liu et al. (2024d): items that all models solve correctly are removed, whereas items all models fail to solve undergo manual review and correction.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: Gemini Comanici et al. (2025) generates structured annotations—task summaries, step-wise instructions with timestamps, and metadata (objects, actions, scenes, embodiments)—which are refined by human annotators.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: We introduce RoboBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating MLLMs as embodied brains across 5 key dimensions, spanning 14 capabilities, 25 tasks, and 6092 QA pairs.
